_README: THE AUTHORITATIVE CENSUS of every §265 verbatim-__asm__ body — assembly posing as C.
Derived once (P31 S75) from the ROM image, the PsyQ archive symbol tables, and the
<OBJ>_OBJ_<hex> naming key (= placed_object.text_start + hex). NOT re-derived by regex:
five successive regex censuses gave 116/112/108/178/199 and mis-called 154 rows game code
tools/verbatim_check.py diffs the tree against this file and fails on drift.
Dispositions: PERMANENT-VERBATIM (hand asm; never decompilable) · DECOMPILE-NOW ·
DECOMPILE-AS-PARENT (a fragment; decompile its unit_entry, never the fragment) ·
DECOMPILE-LOW-VALUE · UNCERTAIN · NOT-CODE · NOT-VERBATIM (detector false positive).

RATIFIED 2026-09-05 (P31 S80, task #10): the five PERMANENT-VERBATIM rows are hand assembly that no C can reproduce and stay verbatim for the life of the project — main:start (crt0: trapping `addi`, `break 1`, the $gp load), main:__main + main:__do_global_dtors (libgcc2.c compiled -O2 inside the -O0 boot TU; gcc-2.7.2 has no per-function opt level), md_MAIN_003:func_800D3204 + func_800D3234 (trapping `add`/`addi`, `$at`, no frame — MDEC-side). The one GAME-C row (ov_SC03_107:func_8017D878) is decompiled in task #10.

EXTENDED 2026-09-09 (P36 T1b, Drew: 'confirmed per your recommendations'): the IN-FUNCTION form of the lane — a C shell whose whole body is ONE __asm__ statement — was invisible to the file-scope detector and to the P31 S75 derivation. tools/lever_census.py found 23 such routines (2,683 sites: one private copy per overlay + a shared header each, three shared-only). 22 are the original's scratchpad stack-switch trampolines (PERMANENT-VERBATIM, form in-function, binary ov_* = every overlay and the shared headers); func_80184440 is -O0 compiler output and is DECOMPILE-NOW (a Phase-36 residue, counted as a lever). verbatim_check detects the in-function form structurally (the asm is the function's only statement) through lever_census.

2026-09-09 (P36 T1b, second pass): the structural detector found 21 more in-function bodies the §265 lane had banked as raw asm inside C shells and no census had listed: 8 Sony libgs GsTMDfast* renderers in main (SDK-VERBATIM — Sony's code carried as assembly where no SDK object matched), and 13 game bodies (main 8, modules 2, overlays 3) that are DECOMPILE-NOW when compiler-shaped and UNCERTAIN when they carry a hand-asm marker; both stay LEVERS in tools/lever_census.py until resolved.
